svg.title: mod-ui, HMI, Control Chain, mod-host and JACK in detail
svg.desc: The modules of the Python process and the native library, the three device peers and the JACK graph, with the protocol on each link: the Host reaches mod-host over TCP, the HMI over serial, Control Chain over a unix socket and libmod_utils through ctypes, and libmod_utils is itself a JACK client.
svg.text: MOD-UI · ONE PYTHON PROCESS · ONE THREAD
The JACK thread of libmod_utils only
so everything stays on one thread.
HTTP and WebSocket clients, not drawn
